title: Removing the only entry of a single-pair mapping in a flow sequence leaves {}
notes: The item is a mapping with one pair. Removing the pair leaves an empty mapping, which is written `{}`, as any emptied mapping is (docs/edit-semantics.md); the sequence keeps its item.

provenance.reference: A writer that cut out the key and left `: 0` behind, which reads back as a different value.
